s_9.title: A signature through Diia is equivalent to a handwritten signature
s_9.description: The Law on Electronic Trust Services gives a qualified electronic signature (QES) the same legal effect as a handwritten signature. A decision made in the system is not a chat poll. It is a document with a QES that can be submitted to a registrar and used in court.

s_9.list_1_3_label:
every call to Diia
is logged and can be checked
s_9.list_2_1_description: We turn the ballot text into a digital fingerprint. That fingerprint is what gets signed — the text cannot be substituted.
s_9.list_2_2_description: The member signs the document in the Diia app. The signature is sent directly from Diia to our server.
s_9.list_2_3_description: We check it against the accredited key certification authority’s certificate chain. If verification fails, the vote is not recorded. If it passes, the vote and proof are saved in the log.

s_2.title_2: Is voting with a signature through Diia legally valid?
s_2.text_2: The Law on Electronic Trust Services gives a qualified electronic signature (QES) the same legal effect as a handwritten signature. A signature in Diia is a QES. The ballot therefore has the same legal effect as one signed on paper.
s_2.title_3: Can I explore the system without registering?
s_2.text_3: Yes. The mobile app has a limited demo mode. We will show you the rest at a meeting.
s_2.title_4: Can I give different people different permissions?
s_2.text_4: Yes. The organization’s main administrator receives access first. They then assign roles: some people can edit data, while others can only view it.
s_2.title_5: What if I am in several organizations?
s_2.text_5: Yes. You can belong to several organizations, with different roles in each. Each organization issues its own QR card for access.

privacy_policy.text_1_1: The OrganizationOffice platform is currently operating in test mode. Some features may be temporarily unavailable or unstable. Technical malfunctions or errors may occur during use.
privacy_policy.text_1_2: To improve quality, stability and security, we may collect technical information about user interactions with the system. This data is used solely for internal analysis and is not shared with third parties, except in cases provided for by law.
privacy_policy.text_1_3: The processing of personal data is carried out in accordance with the Law of Ukraine 'On Personal Data Protection' No. 2297-VI of June 1, 2010 (as amended on 14.06.2025).
privacy_policy.text_1_4: The official text of the law is available at:
privacy_policy.text_1_5: Collected personal data is not transferred to third parties, except in cases provided by current legislation.
privacy_policy.text_1_6: The user has all the rights of a personal data subject in accordance with the Law of Ukraine 'On Personal Data Protection'.
privacy_policy.text_1_7: For questions regarding the processing of personal data, please contact:
privacy_policy.text_2_2: The OrganizationOffice platform (hereinafter - 'Platform', 'We') establishes the principles for collecting, processing, storing, and protecting users' personal data (hereinafter - 'You', 'Users') when using our web resources and services.
privacy_policy.title_3: 1. Collection and Processing of Personal Data
privacy_policy.text_3_1: The Platform collects and processes users' personal data to provide access to services, support functionality, and comply with legal requirements.
privacy_policy.list_3_1_1: Identification and contact data: name, email address, phone number.
privacy_policy.list_3_1_2: Technical information: IP address, browser type and version, device model, operating system, interface language, date and time of access, pages visited.
privacy_policy.list_3_1_3: Interaction data: user actions within the service, requests to support, profile settings, selected features.
privacy_policy.list_3_2_1: providing access to platform functionality and personalization;
privacy_policy.list_3_2_2: technical support and communication with users;
privacy_policy.list_3_2_3: analytics, monitoring stability, and resolving technical issues;
privacy_policy.list_3_2_4: complying with legal requirements regarding personal data processing.
privacy_policy.title_4: 2. Transfer and Storage of Personal Data
privacy_policy.text_4_1: Personal data is not shared with third parties without your explicit consent, except where such a transfer is necessary under applicable law.
privacy_policy.text_4_1_1: Data may be shared only in the following cases:
privacy_policy.list_4_1: fulfilling legal obligations under Ukrainian law;
privacy_policy.list_4_2: involving authorized service providers (contractors, hosting providers, analytics platforms) that ensure the technical functioning of the platform, provided they comply with personal data protection requirements;
privacy_policy.list_4_3: in the event of reorganization, merger, asset transfer, or other corporate change – provided the privacy policy continuity is ensured.
privacy_policy.text_4_2_1: Personal data is stored for no more than 5 years from the last user activity, unless a different period is determined by legal requirements or service terms.
privacy_policy.text_5_1: Every user has legally guaranteed rights regarding their personal data. You have the right to:
privacy_policy.list_5_1: receive confirmation of the processing of your personal data and access to it;
privacy_policy.list_5_2: request clarification, updating, correction, or deletion of inaccurate or outdated data;
privacy_policy.list_5_3: withdraw consent to personal data processing at any time (if processing is based on consent);
privacy_policy.list_5_4: object to processing in cases provided by law;
privacy_policy.list_5_5: restrict processing in certain cases (e.g., during verification of data accuracy);
privacy_policy.list_5_6: file a complaint with the Authorized Body for Personal Data Protection.
privacy_policy.text_5_2: Requests to exercise rights should be sent to the email address:
privacy_policy.text_6_1: We implement modern technical and organizational measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, loss, or destruction.
privacy_policy.text_7_1: We reserve the right to periodically make changes to this Privacy Policy. All updates are published on the official website and take effect upon posting.
privacy_policy.text_7_2: In case of significant changes, we will notify you in advance – by email, through the platform interface, or by other convenient means.
